verdict.rationale: The evidence has no documented ops-user export of the complete cap table or full transaction history to Excel or CSV. What it does show are developer API endpoints that return cap table, stakeholder, option grant and convertible note data. Those are building blocks a developer could turn into an export, not the export capability itself, and there is no endpoint for full transaction history. The Excel output in the Investors MCP plugin covers fund budgets and P&L, which is a different capability.
